completion_evidence: Owned-board maker/revision, manufacturer schematic and measured header/outline identity.
Reviewed GPIO, boot/PSRAM reservations, normal/fault I/O and power paths reconciled to the frozen Nano baseline.
field_tasks.next_action: Reconcile the focused spec's frozen Nano ESP32 with headers against the later owner-requested Pi + Arduino cassette and photographed UNO-format candidate linked to DIYables ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8. Verify the actual board manufacturer/revision, schematic, header pin numbering and voltage/power limits; the source match is not owned-board verification.

completion_evidence: Reviewed sidecar/shield/replacement decision with actual mounting location and populated envelope.
Controller/ADC/storage/service boundaries and inter-board connector/net mapping.
field_tasks.next_action: Choose a separate sensor PCB, a shield, or an integrated replacement. The current UNO mounting plane already carries the controller; this reference does not create space for a second board.

completion_evidence: Exact Sensata HIGH orderable configuration, datasheet and mating connector/fitting.
Reviewed supply/output/fault/transfer/absolute-reference limits and calibration procedure.
field_tasks.next_action: The focused spec freezes the Sensata A/C analog family, 5 V option and 0.6-35 barA baseline, but explicitly leaves the orderable PN TBD. Obtain the exact configuration, connector/cavity pin map, supply/output limits, transfer, faults, calibration and refrigerant/port configuration. The older Honeywell candidate is not a substitution.

completion_evidence: Exact Sensata LOW orderable configuration, datasheet and mating connector/fitting.
Independent LOW range, transfer, faults and calibration; no copied HIGH calibration.
field_tasks.next_action: The focused spec freezes the Sensata A/C analog family and 0.6-10.25 barA LOW baseline with exact PN TBD. Resolve its configuration independently; do not copy HIGH calibration or substitute an older sealed-gauge candidate.

completion_evidence: Selected contact and ambient probes, interfaces, harness and attachment method.
Range/error/excitation/fault/response/calibration limits approved for the measurement roles.
field_tasks.next_action: The focused spec leaves automotive contact probes at SELECT. Older bench references are Adafruit PT1000 #3984 with MAX31865 #3648; earlier CAD also lists SHT40 #4885, which is not a line-contact probe. Select final contact/ambient parts, interfaces, excitation, range, attachment, connectors, faults and calibration.

completion_evidence: Vehicle source/connector and measured or authoritative normal/crank/transient/fault envelope.
Power-tree/current/hold-up-or-restart/protection calculations with reviewed acceptance limits.
field_tasks.next_action: Resolve fused source, continuous/current/startup loads, minimum crank voltage/duration, required hold-up or controlled restart, reverse-polarity and surge waveform limits.

completion_evidence: Exact regulator and independent switches with upstream node and normal/fault limits.
Startup/leakage/back-power/thermal calculations and review at the actual ambient/load envelope.
field_tasks.next_action: Independent sensor 5 V is required; TPS7B83-Q1 is explicitly a candidate. Freeze the regulator, upstream node, tolerance, startup/short limits, independent channel switches, off-state behavior and thermal budget at actual ambient temperature.

completion_evidence: Actual Pi/HAT identity, bench-only or installation boundary, power budget and communication contract.
Preserve two mounting planes; exclude the modeled lithium UPS from underhood use.
field_tasks.next_action: The owner requested separate Pi and Arduino mounting planes; CAD identifies Waveshare UPS HAT (D). Resolve the actual Pi computer model, bench/vehicle role, separate power budget and communication link. HAT identity does not establish a Pi model, and the modeled lithium UPS is prohibited underhood.

completion_evidence: Actual GPIO/ADC/reference/divider/protection allocation for seven analog observations.
Reviewed and measured conversion/settling/filter schedule at requested channel rates and all power states.
field_tasks.next_action: Resolve the seven analog observations versus four ADC inputs, GPIO assignments, reference source, filtering, divider tolerances, settling and power-off input protection.

completion_evidence: Selected socket/breakout/card, SPI pin map, voltage domain, card detect and insertion envelope.
Measured startup/write load and reviewed power-loss recovery protocol.
field_tasks.next_action: The focused V0 baseline freezes Adafruit microSD #4682 plus a 16-64 GB high-endurance card and calls for a socket/card-detect implementation on the custom PCB. Freeze the PCB socket, voltage domain, GPIO/SPI assignments, card detect, insertion clearance and startup/write current.

completion_evidence: Exact connector halves, seals, cavity/pin map, wire gauge and source/calibration links.
Measured cable OD, bend/mating travel, strain relief and actual enclosure termination locations.
field_tasks.next_action: Freeze actual sensor/internal disconnect/power connectors, pin maps, locations, cable OD and bend radius, latch/pull travel and strain relief.

completion_evidence: Final outline/holes/tolerances, populated heights and antenna/USB/SD/connector keepouts.
Populated STEP cross-fit and actual mounting/connector coupon evidence for the retained cassette revision.
field_tasks.next_action: Resolve the final board role and outline, attachment, board stacking, populated heights, antenna/USB access and physical mounting coupon evidence.

completion_evidence: Selected supplier/stackup/copper/finish and explicit fabrication/assembly/package rules.
Complete approved component/footprint/model provenance and reviewed export/DFM profile.
field_tasks.next_action: Freeze board stackup, copper, supplier rules, finish, assembly/package capabilities and component lifecycle/availability.

completion_evidence: Application-specific temperature/transient/vibration/ingress/EMC limits and test programme.
Named engineering reviewer, fixture/instrument/calibration/uncertainty and numeric measurement acceptance limits.
field_tasks.next_action: Resolve actual component/enclosure temperature limits, electrical/transient/environment/EMC acceptance criteria, fixtures, measurement uncertainty and reviewer.

limitations: Source hashes establish exact submitted bytes, not source truth, independent approval or component qualification.
Plan coverage records intended work and tests. It does not establish their implementation, execution or successful outcome.
The report does not run native EDA, simulations, manufacturing checks, firmware builds, or physical measurements.
Field provenance and existing requirement trace outcomes are inspected; no confirmation, approval or lifecycle record is issued.
Even a fully populated plan and BoardSpec require the supported compiler, reviewed assets, native verification and separate approvals.

requirements.statement: Measure distinct HIGH and LOW pressure channels. Preserve raw ADC, voltage, calibration identity and absolute/gauge reference; publish no engineering pressure without exact validated calibration.
Provide selected high-line, low-line and ambient temperature inputs; cabin return and center vent are optional extensions. Internal die temperature remains BOARD_DIE_HEALTH_ONLY.

Use fused switched vehicle power, reverse-polarity/transient protection, a controller-compatible regulated supply and an independent sensor 5 V supply. Keep USB service available and record reset/brownout evidence.
Independently switch HIGH and LOW sensor power. Account for signal back-powering, off-state leakage and independent fault recovery.
Use an ADS1115-Q1-class protected/scaled ADC path unless measured evidence supports the controller ADC. Include a known reference and all required rail measurements.
Retain microSD logging, raw observations, versioned health and calibration evidence, with power-loss/recovery tests. The current recovery firmware does not implement these paths.
Retain USB flashing/debug and versioned recovery. BLE/SoftAP are later runtime features, absent from EMPTY_RECOVERY and TEMPERATURE_BENCH.
Carry over the current matched enclosure revision. Revalidate any new PCB, shield stack, connector, harness or power-entry geometry against actual exported shell/cassette solids.

Require native ERC/DRC, independent engineering review, exact manufacturing artifacts and measured bench results before fabrication/vehicle qualification. Component ratings and CAD clearance do not certify the complete assembly.

deliverables: Typed source-bound review CLI and plan schema.
Real A/C regression snapshot, unsafe-input mutations and deterministic reports.
Existing supported creation-path replay with explicit evidence scope.

tests.acceptance: Deterministic exact-byte reports; fourteen current composite blockers visible; unsafe inputs refused without partial output or source edits; all release authorities remain false.
tests.procedure: Run the real source-bound BoardSpec/build-plan review twice. Mutate source bytes/hashes, identities, field and requirement coverage, dependencies, schema, paths and claimed test/approval states in isolated copies.

tests.acceptance: Source bytes agree across rebuilds and match the retained example. Native evidence is identified as historical replay. Success does not expand generator scope to the automotive A/C board.
tests.procedure: Generate the supported LED candidate twice using its retained typed recipe; compare actual native files and replay the retained Orion native export/check evidence. Test unsupported input rejection.

tests.acceptance: Exact product contracts and normal/fault limits are resolved and signed by the appropriate independent engineering authority; source contradictions are closed.
tests.procedure: Review the selected architecture, exact block interfaces, power/fault calculations, GPIO/net/ADC schedule and required manufacturer evidence.

tests.acceptance: No unwaived errors, hidden exclusions or ignored severities; each preregistered defect is detected; missing models/evidence block the applicable requirement. Actual raw native reports and source identities retained.
tests.procedure: Use a pinned, registered Orion profile to reopen the functional schematic/PCB, run full ERC/DRC/parity and applicable simulations, then inject omissions, wrong pins/nets, shorts, polarity and rule violations into isolated copies.

tests.acceptance: Measured voltages/current/waveforms/temperature and fault response meet exact reviewed limits with instrument uncertainty, assembly identity and calibration recorded.
tests.procedure: On an approved assembled unit and current-limited fixture, measure startup, rails, idle/max load, reverse/fault response and required crank restart/hold-up. Switch each sensor independently and measure off-state signal back-power and thermal behaviour.

tests.acceptance: Retain raw ADC/voltage and exact calibration/absolute-reference identity; engineering values and fault quality meet reviewed limits. No generic transfer is substituted.
tests.procedure: Stimulate both exact selected pressure paths at calibrated endpoints and intermediate values; check reference/rail error, open/short/unpowered inputs, ground offset, filtering/settling and actual channel rates.

tests.acceptance: Actual external readings meet the selected probe/interface/calibration limits. Missing probes remain unavailable, and die-health temperature is never reported as line temperature.
tests.procedure: Stimulate the selected high-line, low-line and ambient probes across approved temperature points. Measure attachment error/response and open/short/stuck behaviour; check firmware role labels.

tests.acceptance: Bounded logs preserve raw observations, calibration/version/quality and agreed recovery behaviour; startup/write-current and loss budgets satisfy the reviewed limits.
tests.procedure: Run acquisition/logging at selected rates with the exact card/socket and inject power loss, card removal/write errors and storage limits. Inspect recovered logs and version/quality lineage.

tests.acceptance: Unit/flash identity, backup hashes, serial/boot/rollback/restore evidence and radio-profile observations satisfy the approved service contract.
tests.procedure: On the identified board, exercise backup-first USB service, NVS preservation, probationary boot/rollback and restore. Observe radio absence in EMPTY_RECOVERY and TEMPERATURE_BENCH; test any later approved runtime link separately.

tests.acceptance: Digital and measured physical clearances/tolerances match the reviewed assembly. A rectangular mounting reference or earlier unused space reservation cannot satisfy this test.
tests.procedure: Cross-fit the exact populated board and connector/harness STEP assembly against the retained shell/cassette; verify the actual boards, screws, holes, cable bends, connector mating travel, USB and card service access.

tests.acceptance: The exact reviewed source and complete manufacturing package agree under the selected supplier profile, with independent rotation/pick-point and technical review. Missing checks remain incomplete.
tests.procedure: Export the actual native BOM/CPL/Gerber/drill/PDF/STEP set on Orion. Compare references/DNP, exact part/footprint identity, origin/units/side/rotation and independent CAM geometry; mutate omissions, substitutions and coordinates.

tests.acceptance: Approvals come from authorized independent participants and bind exact dependencies. Changed sources invalidate approvals; a plan, family rating or software test is not release authority.
tests.procedure: Review the exact requirement, architecture, schematic, layout, calculation, simulation, export and test hashes through the existing separate engineering/fabrication authority workflow.

tests.acceptance: All applicable numeric limits, uncertainty, assembly/calibration identities and observed failures/results are recorded. No public/transportation/military compliance is inferred from component ratings.
tests.procedure: After installation/service approval, run the application-specific crank/transient, thermal, vibration, ingress/condensation and EMC programme with the actual assembly and fixtures.
